spec.rawSql:
SELECT district, COUNT(*) AS listings
FROM public.apartments_analysis
WHERE district IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(city, '') ~ '${city:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(district, '') ~ '${district:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(parking, '') ~ '${parking:regex}'
  AND (
      COALESCE(metro_1, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
      OR COALESCE(metro_2, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
      OR COALESCE(metro_3, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
  )
GROUP BY district
ORDER BY listings DESC;

SELECT
    district,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5)
        WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_rub)) AS median_price
FROM public.apartments_analysis
WHERE price_rub > 0
  AND district IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(city, '') ~ '${city:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(district, '') ~ '${district:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(parking, '') ~ '${parking:regex}'
  AND (
      COALESCE(metro_1, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
      OR COALESCE(metro_2, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
      OR COALESCE(metro_3, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
  )
GROUP BY district
ORDER BY median_price DESC;

spec.title: Median Price per m² by District

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    district,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5)
        WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_per_sqm)) AS median_price_per_sqm
FROM public.apartments_analysis
WHERE price_per_sqm > 0
  AND district IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(city, '') ~ '${city:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(district, '') ~ '${district:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(parking, '') ~ '${parking:regex}'
  AND (
      COALESCE(metro_1, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
      OR COALESCE(metro_2, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
      OR COALESCE(metro_3, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
  )
GROUP BY district
ORDER BY median_price_per_sqm DESC;

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(
        LEAST(
            metro_time_min,
            metro_2_time_min,
            metro_3_time_min
        )
    ), 1) AS average_metro_time
FROM public.apartments_analysis
WHERE COALESCE(city, '') ~ '${city:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(district, '') ~ '${district:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(parking, '') ~ '${parking:regex}'
  AND (
      COALESCE(metro_1, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
      OR COALESCE(metro_2, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
      OR COALESCE(metro_3, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
  );

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN access_time <= 5 THEN '0–5 min'
        WHEN access_time <= 10 THEN '6–10 min'
        WHEN access_time <= 15 THEN '11–15 min'
        WHEN access_time <= 20 THEN '16–20 min'
        ELSE '20+ min'
    END AS metro_access,
    COUNT(*) AS listings
FROM (
    SELECT
        LEAST(
            metro_time_min,
            metro_2_time_min,
            metro_3_time_min
        ) AS access_time
    FROM public.apartments_analysis
    WHERE COALESCE(city, '') ~ '${city:regex}'
      AND COALESCE(district, '') ~ '${district:regex}'
      AND COALESCE(parking, '') ~ '${parking:regex}'
      AND (
          COALESCE(metro_1, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
          OR COALESCE(metro_2, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
          OR COALESCE(metro_3, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
      )
) t
WHERE access_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY metro_access
ORDER BY MIN(access_time);

SELECT metro, COUNT(*) AS listings
FROM (
    SELECT listing_id, metro_1 AS metro
    FROM public.apartments_analysis

    UNION ALL

    SELECT listing_id, metro_2
    FROM public.apartments_analysis

    UNION ALL

    SELECT listing_id, metro_3
    FROM public.apartments_analysis
) m
JOIN public.apartments_analysis a USING (listing_id)
WHERE metro IS NOT NULL
  AND BTRIM(metro) <> ''
  AND COALESCE(a.city, '') ~ '${city:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(a.district, '') ~ '${district:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(a.parking, '') ~ '${parking:regex}'
  AND metro ~ '${metro:regex}'
GROUP BY metro
ORDER BY listings DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN passenger_lift = 0 THEN 'No passenger lift'
        WHEN passenger_lift = 1 THEN '1 passenger lift'
        WHEN passenger_lift = 2 THEN '2 passenger lifts'
        ELSE '3+ passenger lifts'
    END AS lift_category,
    COUNT(*) AS listings
FROM public.apartments_analysis
WHERE passenger_lift IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(city, '') ~ '${city:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(district, '') ~ '${district:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(parking, '') ~ '${parking:regex}'
  AND (
      COALESCE(metro_1, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
      OR COALESCE(metro_2, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
      OR COALESCE(metro_3, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
  )
GROUP BY lift_category
ORDER BY MIN(passenger_lift);

SELECT
    parking,
    COUNT(*) AS listings
FROM public.apartments_analysis
WHERE parking IS NOT NULL
  AND BTRIM(parking) <> ''
  AND COALESCE(city, '') ~ '${city:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(district, '') ~ '${district:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(parking, '') ~ '${parking:regex}'
  AND (
      COALESCE(metro_1, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
      OR COALESCE(metro_2, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
      OR COALESCE(metro_3, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
  )
GROUP BY parking
ORDER BY listings DESC;

SELECT
    district,
    COUNT(*) AS listings,
    ROUND(AVG(LEAST(
        metro_time_min,
        metro_2_time_min,
        metro_3_time_min
    )), 1) AS avg_metro_time,
    ROUND(AVG(passenger_lift), 2) AS avg_passenger_lifts,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE parking IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM(parking) <> ''
    ) AS listings_with_parking,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE yard IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM(yard) <> ''
    ) AS listings_with_yard_info
FROM public.apartments_analysis
WHERE district IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(city, '') ~ '${city:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(district, '') ~ '${district:regex}'
  AND COALESCE(parking, '') ~ '${parking:regex}'
  AND (
      COALESCE(metro_1, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
      OR COALESCE(metro_2, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
      OR COALESCE(metro_3, '') ~ '${metro:regex}'
  )
GROUP BY district
ORDER BY listings DESC;
